notes.title: DEMO 1.6 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello, crew members!

It's update time for our demo! This update focuses on balancing, ease of use, and design improvements.

https://i.postimg.cc/GmM808mN/10-ezgif-com-optimize.gif

1. Virtualize Stamina
We’ve redesigned how turrets are used. "Virtualize Time" has been replaced with Virtualize Stamina, a new system and UI that surrounds turrets instead of being displayed on the control panel screen.

Key changes:
- Players can now take damage while controlling turrets instead of being teleported back after one hit
- Damage is subtracted from Virtualize Stamina rather than instantly ejecting the player
- This allows for more turret use and reduces unwanted teleportation across the screen
- More UI elements to improve awareness

https://i.postimg.cc/vmk4BJ9t/11-ezgif-com-optimize.gif

2. Improved Agent Movement
We’ve adjusted how agents position themselves in battle, making hacking and melee attacks easier.

3. Character Ability Fixes & Improvements
AIO 
- enemies shoot after a delay when Invisibility stops or pauses
Nero 
- Virus can control multiple turrets at once, and works alongside Harra agent
- improved turret shield functionality
Tina
- fixed critical hits skill upgrade
Vex
- bigger acid bombs with increased orbital speed and range
Lora
- increased range for Time Warp and skill upgrade

Going STEALTH with Invisibility
https://i.postimg.cc/TwbpWtJM/13-ezgif-com-optimize.gif
 
Other improvements/fixes include:
- lower memory needed for all agent versions and rarities
- added upgrade stations and damage doors to tutorial
- added more time to wire travel when getting thrown out of CPs
- removed auto-equip mission prize item on mission complete
- removed auto-move cursor back to drive after equipping items
- added an attack delay for enemies when player gets thrown out of CPs
- add legendary icon to planet map legend
- add more info about weapon upgrading in help wizard
- fixed agents remaining stuck (paused) inside tiles after cutscenes
- fixed agent shields not working with boss beam shield
- stop gamepad vibration if orpad is opened
- fixed legendary agent level on hack for faster equipping

Thanks for playing and Happy Hacking!

PS: How many bots are too many bots?
https://i.postimg.cc/fbJ3Mz3b/12-ezgif-com-optimize.gif

notes.title: DEMO 1.5 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Greetings, crew members!

It’s update time for our demo, and boy is this a big one. We’ve been working hard on adding new and interesting features that actually change how you play and make every run different. The previous update was the first step in this direction, making every character unique. Here is what the new update brings:

1. PASSIVE ITEMS THAT MATTER 

We added new mechanics so every passive item can add some kind of meaningful upgrade that can change how you play and approach enemies. These items can also affect your agents and their bullets.
Here’s the full list of items you can find in the demo:

Vigor Bifocals - See enemy health and level.
Observers ST - See nemy state and target.
X-Ray Googles - Reveal nearby secrets.
Disk-LSR Visor - See invisible enemies.
Assassin Shades - See enemy elemental weakness.
Heat-R Mask - Burning enemies emit fire sparks, that burn enemies in contact.
Caustic Respirator - Eroding enemies leak acid, that erodes enemies in contact.
Shock Helmet - Arcs connect electricity bullets. Arcs stun enemies and destroy their bullets.
Plasma RS-2 - Plasma projectiles accelerate to a higher maximum speed.
HP Protector - Dead enemies spawn small health boosts.
Blaze Buster - Dash to leave a fire trail, burning enemies in contact.
Neocerbic Vest - Dash to create a chemical cloud with eroding acid rain.
Equaliser Garment - Dash through enemies to stun them.
Sigma Waistcoat - Dash through enemies to deal plasma damage.
Tactical Takedown Vest - Crouch and aim to create a shield in front of your weapon.
Jet Pack - Fly up by burning fuel. Touch the ground to recharge fuel.
Fire Fenders - Enemies that die from fire, set close enemies on fire.
Chemical Bogs - Enemy explosions become chemical, spreading acidic drops.
Grounded Shoes - Kill to become electrified and stun nearby enemies.
Plasma Kicks - Enemy explosions spawn a plasma star, targeting nearby enemies.
Agile Cleats – Kills or dealing damage instantly recharge dash.
Invisi Boots - Crouch to become invisible.
Flaming Ground - Speed fall to the ground to create a burning ring of fire. 
Synthetic Mist - Speed fall to the ground to create an eroding chemical mist. 
Rising Voltage - Speed fall to the ground to electrify it. 
Charged Pulse - Speed fall to the ground to create a plasma shock wave. 
HH Igniters - Burning enemy bullets are slower.
Corrosive Gloves - Eroding enemies move slower.
Static Enhancers - Stunned enemies create chain lightning to nearby enemies.
Fusion Enablers - Plasma attacks knockback enemies. Powerful attacks have more knockback force.
Extra Memory - Repaired agents have a shield for a short time.
Hacking Device - Repair an agent to create a wave that knocks back enemies and destroys bullets.
Probability Cube - Unaware enemies are more likely to endure critical hits.
Virtual Jump - Jump more times. Touch the ground to recharge jumps.
 
Tactical Takedown
https://i.postimg.cc/FK7c1X1c/Tactical-Takedown.gif

Grounded Shoes
https://i.postimg.cc/nhdBHhVp/Grounded-Shoes.gif


2. GADGETS

This is a new feature that replaces the already existing grenades. 
Here is a list of all the gadgets available in the demo:

Grenade - Explodes after a short time. (also available in versus mode)
Impact Bomb - Explodes on impact. (also available in versus mode)
Mine – Sticks to walls and explodes when enemies are nearby. (also available in versus mode)
Boomerang - Flies through enemies and walls. Comes back to the player. (also available in versus mode)
Agent Shields - Shields all equipped agents for a short time.
Remote Fix - Repairs nearby wrecked agents.
Tesla Coil - Sticks to walls and stuns nearby enemies. (also available in versus mode)
Erosive Gas - Bounces of walls and emits an acidic gas, eroding enemies that touch it. (also available in versus mode)
Flaming Kunai - Sticks to enemies and walls. Explodes after a short time, burning nearby enemies. (also available in versus mode)

Tesla Coil
https://i.postimg.cc/g0QhZt67/Tesla-Coil.gif

Flaming Kunai
https://i.postimg.cc/SNfcvGwX/Flaming-Kunai.gif

Now here’s the fun part, SYNERGIES. More items can be combined together with elemental weapons, agents, skills and gadgets to create overpowered builds.

Electricity build with Shokai agents, electric pistol, Shock Helmet, Static Enhancers and Jet Pack
https://i.postimg.cc/mkQ7R3k5/Electricity-Synergy.gif

Acid build with Vex, acid sniper, Caustic Respirator, Corrosive Gloves and Synthetic Mist
https://i.postimg.cc/brX1KVyn/Acid-Synergy.gif

Dash build with Lora, HP Protector, Sigma Waistcoat and Agile Cleats
https://i.postimg.cc/zGDTZgrx/Plasma-Dash-Synergy.gif


3. VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS
Is it cyberpunk without fog and rain? Well, yes, but fog and rain certainly look cool and really help the whole atmosphere of the game.
https://i.postimg.cc/ryW1STjN/Fog-And-Rain.gif

Beside all these additions, the update comes with a bunch of fixes and quality of life improvements.
We are very excited to see what crazy builds you discover, so come join our DISCORD, where you can share your runs or cool stuff you find. 

PS: The demo is available for both Windows and MacOS (Silicon).

Thanks for playing!
George and Tibi
Early Sun Games

notes.title: DEMO 1.4 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello crew members!

We are very happy to be part of the Steam Endless Replayability Festival. 
To celebrate we updated our demo with a bunch of cool stuff (list below).
Thanks for all your feedback! We highly appreciate it, as it helps us make Sinus better.

New character: Vex

https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaHFzaTFsOXBsZTBmbnZnanp5eWxyc2hoejgyeTN3Z3d2M3Q3YWNtayZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/b2fqMjf0dIivDgnAZ5/giphy.gif
Vex is an elite warrior from planet Wigua. 
Ability: Acid Barrier - Spawns powerful acid bombs around him, that knockback enemies and deal erossion.
Trait: Reptile Flux - Health regen in small doses.

New character: Lora

https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb3huY3o1czV2OGQ5bmdtZnMwMTM2ZTlvdXdmMWt4aTljZmgxdzhjYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/bNQS3RFLWNBUXhWICK/giphy.gif
Lora is a scientist from planet Saphed.
Ability: Time Warp - Bends time around her to slow down enemy bullets.
Trait: Wuxia - Dashes in double time.

Nero, Tina, and AIO's abilities and traits have also been changed, polished and tweaked.
Nero can now spawn shields to turrets controlled by his Virus ability.
Besides Double Damage, Tina now has a high chance to deal critical hits. She also regenerates grenade ammo.
AIO's ability has been completely reworked. He can now turn invisible for a short time and has extra sword damage and attack rate.


NEW STUFF:
- extra playable characters in Campaign and Versus game modes
- plasma weapons can now deal critical hits
- better, punchier turrets
- new critical hit related weapon upgrades
- weapon upgrade chips can now be picked up in your backpack for future use
- inventory weapon upgrade system
- bigger items UI
- new and fleshed out weapons UI
- new tutorial

I won't bother you with a long list of improvements and fixes. We've heard you, and added a lot of quality of life changes, so check out this bad boy instead...
https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMnRidm1pYnl3bDYxZ2RsZWNwaDFtd3Zud2gwd2YxaDJseHI3dXpnbiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/bnOwx6xeTZ5h0FvK9T/giphy.gif

Thanks for playing!
George and Tibi
Early Sun Games
